comment: Great professor. she's super nice and cares about how you're doing. Class is not hard as long as you follow directions. Not a lot of homework either, especially if you get it done during class time. Grading was a bit confusing but its her first semester here so she's figuring it out. I would highly recommend her class!

Honestly one of the sweetest professors I have ever had. The tasks/hw for the class are really straightforward and nothing overwhelming. Overall, she is super caring and very easy to work with. Also the GIS course is really useful no matter what your major and just a great skill to have in general. Highly, highly recommend!
